text:
Ava Chen: Heads up — weekly KPI dashboard (pulseboard) shows an 18% drop in webinar -> MQL conversion for cohort submitted last Thu. Anyone else seeing the same?
Sam Bhat: Yep saw that. The time series on pulseboard spikes then declines after the landing page update, will pull raw numbers.
Priya Nair: Could be UTM mapping... we changed the 'source' param on the new form. Might be getting classified as 'unattributed'.
Liam O'Connor: Also flagging a short ingest lag on the lead pipeline during Friday night deploy. Some leads landed in 'unprocessed' bucket.
Jorge Alvarez: Quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT utm_source, count(*) FROM leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-12' AND created_at < '2026-03-19'
GROUP BY utm_source ORDER BY 2 DESC;
```
Results: 480 'null/unset', 390 'webinar_signup_v2', 300 'paid-search'
Ava Chen: null/unset at 480 is the red flag. If UTM dropped, attribution will blame our landing page. Priya, can you confirm frontend mapping?
Priya Nair: On it — checking the form submit payload. @Sam can you share the raw payloads you pulled? :mag_right:
Sam Bhat: Pasted a sample in #eng-analytics earlier, but here's a sanitized payload: `{"utm_source": "", "utm_campaign":"spring-launch"}` — empty source.
Priya Nair: Yup that's the bug. A value check got removed in the v2 form. Reverting now and patching.
marketing-bot: Scheduled weekly KPI digest posted: https://redwood.app/reports/weekly-kpi/1765054321 :bar_chart:
Jorge Alvarez: After fixing, we should recalc conversion using only leads reprocessed. I can kick reprocessing job: `jobs/reprocess_unattributed_leads --since 2026-03-12`
Liam O'Connor: Recommend we also add a dashboard widget for 'unattributed leads over time' so this is more visible.
Ava Chen: Agreed. Action items: Priya revert + patch, Jorge reprocess, Sam validate post-reprocess numbers, Liam add widget. Quick huddle tomorrow 9am PT to confirm. :thumbsup:
Sam Bhat: Will validate and post numbers in this thread once done.
Priya Nair: Reverted and deployed v2. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing-forms/pull/482 — roll-forward in 10m.
Jorge Alvarez: Reprocess kicked. ETA ~7m. Will report counts when finished.
marketing-bot: Reprocess job complete: 452 leads reclassified, 410 assigned to 'webinar_signup_v2'.
Sam Bhat: Post-reprocess conversion restored to +2% vs baseline (was -18). Closing loop for this week's KPI variance.
Ava Chen: Great — can someone add a short note to the weekly KPI report explaining the variance and the fix? I'll add to the narrative: 'drop caused by form UTM removal; corrected and reprocessed leads.'
Liam O'Connor: Added widget ticket to backlog #MARK-721.
Ava Chen: Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
